top_issues: Card clutter: the 'How to read this' explanatory banner pushes primary asset actions and account lists below the fold.
Divergent scale cues: the triple-color unified scale bar above balances lacks explicit tick marks or direct anchor tags.
fixes: Collapse 'How to read this' into an info-icon tooltip or dismissable pill to surface the balances list immediately.
Add subtle numeric anchor ticks or segment labels directly beneath the top absolute-scale multi-segment bar.

top_issues: Low contrast micro-copy: 'send up to 175.00' and 'receive up to 0.50' sit in muted text against dark card background.
Ambiguous status dot: recent swap item shows generic 'closed' gray status dot without explicit trade direction or fill outcome.
fixes: Increase font contrast on account capacity indicators to at least #94A3B8.
Add paired asset symbol or arrow badge to recent swap items (e.g. 'USDC → WETH') alongside the status tag.

top_issues: Target hex address in recipient box is truncated and rendered in low contrast, weakening verification before send.
Inline route widget uses nested badge chips ('You -> H1 -> H2') that crowd vertical rhythm on smaller viewports.
fixes: Display recipient identity with formatted checksum chunking and an explicit verified domain or contact handle.
Streamline the route preview row with a compact segmented indicator and right-aligned hop latency.

top_issues: Route comparison cards repeat identical primary fee structures with minuscule difference (0.000050 vs 0.000075) without explaining reliability tradeoffs.
Primary action button 'Pay 25.00 USDC' hugs the bottom screen border without dynamic home-indicator padding.
fixes: Add a comparative highlight pill ('Lowest fee' vs 'Alternative hub path') to the route selector cards.
Increase safe-area padding below the bottom fixed action button from 16px to 28px.

top_issues: Proof hash is truncated to '0x663df6f3...c556' with no immediate tap-to-verify modal or raw hex copy action.
Background scrim behind sheet still exposes active balances, which can distract from receipt export.
fixes: Make proof row tappable with inline toast 'Proof copied' and an external verification link icon.
Darken the background modal overlay to 0.75 opacity for stronger focal isolation.

top_issues: Receipt bottom-sheet cuts off the top title of the background sheet, creating visual tension at the top edge.
Secondary action buttons ('Copy receipt', 'Download') compete equally in visual weight against 'Done'.
fixes: Snap sheet height to clean 70vh ratio with consistent top scrim margin.
Give 'Copy receipt' a subtle secondary outline and keep 'Done' as the primary saturated fill.

top_issues: Oversized QR container forces all payment link parameters and channel capacity constraints below the fold.
Inbound capacity hint ('25.50 capacity via H1') is tucked into an input field corner, easily missed.
fixes: Reduce QR frame by 20% on viewport widths <= 390px to show destination account and amount input without scroll.
Promote inbound capacity to a dedicated status badge directly under the QR code.

top_issues: Entity ID block contains raw hex string '0x1677a91e...703f88' without a quick 1-tap copy button inside the card.
'Other ways to share' disclosure triangle is low affordance and visually detached from 'Copy payment link'.
fixes: Add explicit icon-button to copy Entity ID directly on the card header.
Group share options into a segmented action bar rather than an expandable text arrow.

top_issues: Heavy tariff disclosure block ('H1 collateral tariff: 0.1 WETH base...') creates dense wall of small text.
Network tag 'Testnet' inside input token selector creates uncertainty whether live assets are traded.
fixes: Collapse collateral tariff formula into a neat 'Fee breakdown' accordion with net received amount prominently displayed.
Move network environment indicator to global header bar instead of within the asset selector.

top_issues: Orderbook ladder on mobile viewport risks thumb interference with the sticky primary swap button below.
Spread indicator is small and centered between ladders, hard to read during quick price swings.
fixes: Add explicit scroll padding between the bottom of the depth ladder and the sticky action button.
Enlarge spread percentage pill with distinct border and neutral contrast background.

top_issues: Grid of 5 action buttons ('Pay', 'Extend credit', 'Swap', 'Manage', 'Dispute') feels fragmented and uneven.
Color legend ('secured', 'promised', 'you owe') uses small dots that are hard to distinguish on dark gray.
fixes: Restructure top actions into primary transaction bar (Pay / Swap) and secondary account actions (Extend credit / Manage / Dispute).
Use pill badges with text tinted to match bar segments for the legend.

top_issues: 'If you dispute, they answer within 1 d' is buried in a dense key-value card without actionable dispute trigger context.
Zero balances on counterparty credit lines clutter the screen without providing actionable data.
fixes: Highlight challenge window duration with a dedicated security icon and countdown badge.
Grey out zero-value line items or collapse empty credit lines under an optional toggle.

top_issues: Filter pills ('All', 'Payments', 'Swaps', 'Settlement', 'Accou...') truncate on standard mobile widths.
Scale indicator under recent transactions lacks dollar value reference labels.
fixes: Enable smooth fade mask on horizontal filter scrolling to indicate more filters exist.
Add min/max scale anchors on the transaction length indicator bars.

top_issues: Modal sheet header 'RECEIPT' is visually overpowered by the huge '-25.00 USDC' headline text.
'2 committed entries' lacks click-to-expand inspector to view individual state transition hashes.
fixes: Tighten typography scale: drop payment amount to 28px and elevate status pill to header row.
Make '2 committed entries' an expandable disclosure item showing sub-frame entries.

top_issues: Dollars per pixel slider control has tiny touch target for thumb positioning on mobile.
Preset pills ('Auto', '$1', '$2', '$5', '$10', '$25', '$100') wrap awkwardly near screen margins.
fixes: Increase slider thumb hit-target to minimum 44x44px.
Make the preset buttons a horizontal scroll bar with equal width capsules.

top_issues: Destructive button 'Forget vault' shares identical card background proximity with safe operational buttons.
At this scale ruler visualization is informative but static, lacking dynamic interactive preview.
fixes: Separate 'Forget vault' into a distinct red-tinted danger zone card at the bottom.
Make scale ruler reactively rescale sample bars when dragging the scale setting above.

top_issues: Tri-state matrix (Wallet / Reserve / Account) repeated twice in 'FROM' and 'TO' causes visual fatigue.
Small account cards cram title, subtitle, balance and scale bar into narrow 1/3 viewport columns.
fixes: Use an interactive transfer switch (From [Dropdown] -> To [Dropdown]) with detailed card preview below.
Increase column width or make source/destination selection a 2-step segmented selector.

top_issues: 'Add to batch' button floats with unclear visual affiliation between the input card and execution button.
'What happens' explanation is long-winded and pushes 'Sign & send' close to device bezel.
fixes: Convert 'Add to batch' into a secondary ghost button paired horizontally with 'Sign & send'.
Summarize 'What happens' in a single concise sentence with an expandable 'Details' link.

top_issues: Navigation grid (Sovereignty, Move, Assets, Lending, Ownership) lacks unread or risk alert indicators.
Summary row 'Yours whatever a hub does' uses colloquial language that may confuse non-native speakers.
fixes: Add subtle status dots or risk counters to the 5 management tiles.
Change 'Yours whatever a hub does' to 'Enforceable On-Chain / Secured'.

top_issues: Depository contract addresses ('0xa513e6...d5c853') are rendered without network logo or explorer link.
'Depository may pull 0.00' is technical jargon that requires contract allowance knowledge.
fixes: Add block explorer external icon next to Depository address.
Replace 'Depository may pull 0.00' with clearer label 'Depository allowance: $0.00'.

top_issues: Debts block is empty text without visual illustration of health status.
Faucets section at bottom is cut off by the navigation bar.
fixes: Add clean checkmark shield icon to 'Debts' section confirming zero outstanding liabilities.
Ensure scrollview has sufficient padding-bottom (96px) above bottom tab bar.

top_issues: Single hub selection tile ('H1 · 3 lanes') looks like an active selection card rather than a picker.
Token selection pills occupy significant vertical space before input controls.
fixes: Make Hub selector a standard compact dropdown row.
Present tokens in a compact segmented strip.

top_issues: H1 Pool statistics ('Available 0.00', 'Borrowed 0.00') are all zero without indicating whether pool is inactive or empty.
Interest rate in basis points (100 = 1.00%) requires financial translation for ordinary users.
fixes: Show pool utilization percentage bar or status tag ('Inactive / Awaiting liquidity').
Offer APY / APR format toggle alongside basis points.

top_issues: Threshold '1 of 1' lacks visual illustration of multisig progression or participant key cards.
'Self-issued (its id is the hash of its board)' is dense cryptographic explanation in a key status field.
fixes: Render visual key avatar chips for threshold signers with '+ Add key' CTA.
Simplify Kind value to 'Self-Issued Board' with explanatory info tooltip.

top_issues: The distinction between '$100.00 Enforceable right now' and '$90.00 Promised' requires reading multi-sentence small print.
Keys card displays hex signers without human-readable wallet labels or hardware signer tags.
fixes: Add breakdown mini-table directly beneath the $100.00 headline contrasting Secured vs Uncovered funds.
Include wallet connection type pill (e.g., 'Software Mnemonic' or 'Passkey/Hardware').

top_issues: 'Save evidence bundle' CTA is prominent but does not state bundle file format (.json / cryptographic zip) or size.
Dispute timeframe summary ('they answer in 1 d, you in 1 d') lacks explanation of what happens if either party times out.
fixes: Add micro-label under CTA: 'Exports verifiable JSON bundle (signatures + Merkle frames)'.
Include link or tooltip explaining the exact slashing/resolution rules on dispute expiry.

overall.verdict: The mobile dark UI achieves exceptional cryptographic rigor and sovereign clarity, visually communicating absolute scale and collateral boundaries better than any existing L2/state-channel wallet. However, it leans heavily on dense technical text and off-chain jargon that can overwhelm retail users while missing cross-chain routing and export actions needed by power treasurers.
priority_fixes: Simplify retail onboarding: replace technical explainers on Home with intuitive 'Secured / At Risk' balance pills and direct Deposit CTA.
Add explicit transaction proof & bundle sharing actions (one-tap exportable JSON receipt + on-chain verification URL) on receipt screens.
Expand the Receive flow with dynamic capacity management alerts so users can request collateral from hubs with one tap.
Surface cross-chain bridge and network destination routes explicitly in the Swap & Pay flows (currently shows single Testnet/H1 paths).
Refine touch targets, safe-area bottom insets, and horizontal scroll indicators across all mobile sheets and filter pills.
